desc: Verify the core lemmas: cost = sum of alphabet distances; feasibility iff n>=3; validity = all maximal runs >=3; capped run length (1/2/3+) suffices as DP state.

Implement backward suffix DP over states {boundary} + 26*3 open-run states with compact flat storage (array('q')); terminal rules: at i=n, boundary and capped-length-3 states cost 0, open lengths 1/2 are invalid (INF).
Implement forward greedy lexicographic reconstruction: at each position try 'a'..'z', keep the first letter whose transition cost + suffix cost achieves the global optimum; return "" when n<3.

Add tests: the three examples, n=1/2/3/4/5, already-good strings, all-same/all-alternating, all 'a'/all 'z', exhaustive 3-letter-alphabet checks (n=3..6), and randomized brute-force comparison for tiny n.
Integrate into Solution.minCostGoodCaption, confirm O(26*3*n) time and memory-conscious storage (~31.6 MB int64), and run full test suite — all exact checks and large-n smoke tests pass.
